How does someone who once seemed so firm lose his way?

Because sometimes the real question isn’t:

It is:

“Did Allah ask to be worshipped this way?”

title: Two Sahabah Who Gave Everything for Knowledge | #2 Stories from Golden Generations of Islam #AMAU
description:
We all say we want to study Islam. To become people of knowledge. But what happens when seeking knowledge begins to cost us comfort? A young Sahabi was told that nobody would ever need him. Years later, senior figures from the Sahabah would sit beside him and listen. Another possessed so little food that he would collapse from hunger; yet went on to preserve more Hadith than any other narrator.

What changed their lives?

It was not talent alone. It was not inspiration. In fact, the Prophet ﷺ had made Du‘a for their knowledge. But there was something else.

In this second episode of Stories from the Golden Generations of Islam, Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble uncovers the hidden struggle behind the knowledge of ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Abbas and Abu Hurayrah رضي الله عنهما.
